findings.title: Unimplemented Phase 5 logic and query placeholders in platform-runtime commands

evidence.observation: Multiple TODO comments indicate stubbed out Phase 5 functionality for authorization checking and memory integration
TODO placeholder for querying quality_anomalies table with empty array fallback

proposed_action.description: Implement the missing Phase 5 Supabase authorization, decision memory integration, and quality anomalies query.

findings.expected_benefit: Completes core runtime commands and removes reliance on unintegrated stubbed logic.

findings.title: Missing Model Router call log file

evidence.observation: Router configuration specifies log_file at /opt/starship-endeavour/core/model-router/call_log.jsonl but call_log_exists is false

proposed_action.description: Ensure the model router creates and logs routing requests to call_log.jsonl properly for observability.

findings.expected_benefit: Restores visibility and telemetry into model router invocations, latency, and failures.

findings.title: Direct LLM API invocations bypassing Model Router

evidence.observation: Direct calls to call_gemini and call_mistral via GEMINI_API_KEY and MISTRAL_API_KEY environment variables instead of using the model router

proposed_action.description: Route emergency alert LLM queries through the centralized Model Router service rather than calling direct third-party SDK functions.

findings.expected_benefit: Enforces unified model routing, quota management, resilience fallbacks, and central telemetry.
